description.to:
Outcome: What a plan includes (custom domains, reader features, newsletters, monitors, AI moderation) is a set of flags on Tenant.entitlements, written by provisioning and by plan changes from Prospectus. A costly action checks its flag on the row it already reads; nothing counts rows to decide. Spend limits are not flags: they are the Prospectus quota check (PPY-889ab5). No seats, no per-agent limits (owner decision 10).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): Tenant model, src/papyrus_content tenancy helpers, the functions that start costly work (content-actions tasks, monitors, newsletter send), the newsroom feature gates.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-entitlements.feature):
Scenario: An action outside the plan is refused with a plain message
    Given "alpha"'s plan does not include newsletters
    When an editor sends a newsletter
    Then it is refused with "Your plan does not include newsletters" and nothing is sent

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-31c45c, PPY-6d9a6d. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Behave.
Rollout: Shared stack; dedicated sites have every flag.
Risk and mitigation: Low.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
